The Tempest's WeaponsDeliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.

Barbecued Buzzard WingsBring 4 Buzzard Wings to Rigglefuzz.Oh yes, my barbecued buzzard wings are a favorite!  The sauce is rich and the meat is tangy.  And the smell will bring the hungry running from miles away!$B$BI have everything I need to cook up a batch.  Everything...except the buzzard wings!$B$BIf you want some then get me the buzzard wings.  Bring me enough, and I might even share the recipe with you!

Martek the ExiledBring Fizzle's Letter to Martek the Exiled in the Badlands.I'm developing a new engine that'll make the car go so fast!  Fast enough to fly, I know it!  I just need to make pistons that can handle very very heavy stress.  All my trials have failed because I can't make pistons hard enough!$B$BBut there is someone who might know how.$B$BHis name is Martek the Exiled.  He is a great smith and knows more about metal than anyone.  Take him this letter, I know he can help!$B$BBut he's far far away -- in Azeroth, in the Badlands, in a camp, with a goblin!$B$BFind him!

Overseas DeliveryDeliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!

Blood of My BloodSlay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?

Test of LoreFind The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.$B$BGo to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.$B$BBring it to me.

Neeka BloodscarSpeak with Neeka Bloodscar.The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.$B$BProve yourself, $n.  Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost.  Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.

Battle of Warsong GulchBring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.$B$BDo not let this happen, $n!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!

Storm, Earth, and FireCollect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.

Shrewd NegotiationsSpeak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
